source.title: Open problems on random band matrices

trace.notes: Input normalized as one zbMATH URL. The trailing identifier 7325761 was matched in the local open-problem catalog to the resolver metadata title "Open problems on random band matrices" with year 2020 and no recorded full-text links.

Failure mode: metadata_only / ambiguous_resolution / network_or_dns_failure. Attempted identifiers and searches included https://zbmath.org/7325761, zbMATH an:7325761, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus 2020, exact title plus Zbl, and exact title plus MathSciNet. Shell fetch of zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution unavailable in the sandbox. Web inspection of the original zbMATH URL and API/OAI-style endpoints did not yield a readable full-text artifact. Exact-title searches surfaced candidates such as the SIGMA article "Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II" and the EMS Magazine page "Solved and unsolved problems", but neither candidate confirmed the same exact title/year/source as zbMATH 7325761, so they were rejected. Search snippets and resolver metadata were not used as technical evidence.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7325761.json and outputs/latest.json.
